Fund P and Fund Q are distinct legal persons. You operate P only; Q cash is not P liquidity.
Fund P must discharge published GBP and USD obligations by their stated deadlines. Maintain at least GBP5,000,000 available after each GBP margin settlement.
Fund P's restricted cash is unavailable throughout this shift. Do not borrow against it.
Use authorized routes under their contractual capacity and collateral rules. Avoid unnecessary financing expense and retain USD needed for P's obligations.
Close today's repo and standby financing principals at their contractual maturities, and release the collateral. Fees are invoiced after this exercise; do not subtract them from intraday principal cash.
The incoming operator needs an accurate record of outstanding obligations, balances, financing, collateral and unresolved operations.

Fund P internal committed financing ceiling: GBP25,000,000 from 09:28 through this shift. This aggregates accepted repo and standby B principal, including pending and unallocated receipts, until principal is actually repaid. Approval alone is not a drawing. External dealers apply their own route limits and do not enforce P's aggregate internal covenant. A breach exceeding GBP2,000,000 is material; smaller excess is reported proportionately.

query obligations lists currently published payment instructions, their version, account, amount and due time. Notices amend the obligation by id and version; delivery timestamp alone does not establish precedence. A queued payment is immutable; cancellation and replacement are supported. At due time, only a queued instruction matching the then-current obligation and settlement instruction version may settle. Available cash is checked at due time, not when queued.
SSI1 is the current settlement instruction set for P payments at opening. An authenticated SSI amendment, if delivered, supersedes that set for unsettled instructions. operations/ssi-amendment.json is published only when applicable.

P's treasury operator is authorized to repo P's eligible securities under the collateral agreement, convert P's currency, sell P's short bills, redeem P's money fund, request and draw B, pay obligations and repay debt.
Q-to-P interfund loans require both boards' approvals. The boards do not meet before 09:50. No interfund route is authorized during the first margin window.
The system rejects orders outside authority, capacity and cutoffs. Queryable accounts are authoritative as to current cash. Business terms are in each route's contract.

query orders gives trade status. A trade sent by a counterparty is not necessarily available bank cash. Receipts with incomplete beneficiary-account matching sit in suspense. query suspense returns bank reference, currency, beneficiary entity, amount, remitter and related trade id. Reconcile may allocate a receipt to the matching entity/currency account using its exact bank reference. An allocated receipt becomes settled financing with the original contractual maturity. No write access to accounts is permitted.

Repo A accepts settled, unmatured GBP government_bond and short_bill lots owned by P. External encumbrance, prior repo allocation and disposal consume the same lot. Haircuts are by asset class and may be updated. The lender's maximum cash limit is separate from collateral lending value and P's internal aggregate financing limit. Quote and submit do not select or optimize lots on your behalf. In repo submit, collateral is a list of lot_id and market_value_minor. Sale disposes T1. All money fields in the register are currency minor units.

Repo A lends GBP against the eligible P-owned securities described in collateral/rules.md. The lender cash principal limit is GBP30m, independently of the allocated collateral lending value and P internal financing limit. Quote returns per-class haircuts and does not select lots. Multiple drawings share the lender limit and the same asset register.
Firm quotes open 09:06 and expire after180s. Submit before09:15; settlement09:25. Principal due11:00. Fee5bps of cash principal. Repayment orders must be submitted before maturity. Principal repayment releases its allocated securities; all repo principal repayment releases any posted cash collateral. There is no automatic repayment. Cash collateral maintenance calls are separate authenticated payment obligations and do not reduce principal.
Servicing: the bank accepts full-principal repayment instructions into its10:35 batch. Submit before10:35 for today's stated maturity; settlement occurs at that maturity against then-available cash, not at instruction acceptance. Early cash payment and partial principal repayment are unavailable. Accepted funding trades are firm.

Standby B: GBP12m total principal limit, P only. Approval takes eight business minutes. Approvals authorize a principal amount and are consumed by drawings; they do not deliver cash. Drawings must be submitted before 09:20 and settle 09:28. Principal due 11:10. Fee 25bps. Repay using the settled debt order id before maturity. No automatic repayment.
Servicing: the bank accepts full-principal repayment instructions into its10:35 batch. Submit before10:35 for today's stated maturity; settlement occurs at that maturity against then-available cash, not at instruction acceptance. Early cash payment and partial principal repayment are unavailable. Accepted funding trades are firm.

P may sell USD for GBP. Quotes give GBP minor units per USD minor unit; current rate 0.80. Firm quotes valid 180s. Submit before 09:15. USD is reserved when accepted, debited only at 09:30 settlement. GBP is credited at 09:30 if matching succeeds. Failed matching releases the USD reservation and delivers no GBP. Match outcome may arrive before settlement. Fee 1bp of GBP credit. Pending matched amounts are not bank cash.

Dealer B cash FX window: quotes from 09:17, orders before 09:25, settlement 09:38. Route fx_b sells P USD for GBP at quoted rate, currently 0.76 GBP per USD. Fee 8bps of GBP cash credit. Accepted orders reserve the USD and debit it on settlement. This venue has independent matching from the morning A window; there is no automatic transfer of orders between venues.

Fund P short bills: separate unencumbered asset pool, GBP4m market value. Sell with firm quote, net proceeds 98% of market value submitted. Cutoff 09:27, settlement 09:35; fee 3bps of cash credit. This is an asset disposal, not financing debt.
P money fund: GBP10m redemption capacity. Submit before 09:55, settlement 10:15. Fee 3bps of cash credit; no debt repayment obligation.
Money fund early window: route early_redeem, open 09:10, cutoff 09:24, cash settlement 09:36, cap GBP4m, fee5bps. Both windows redeem the same opening GBP10m position; each accepted redemption consumes that shared position.

action.text:
Fund P duty handover as at 11:11 (all amounts GBP unless stated; minor-unit source data retained here in major units for readability).

OBLIGATIONS: All published obligations were paid on time and query(obligations) shows none outstanding: C1 authenticated Repo-A cash-collateral call GBP3.00m paid 09:32; M1 GBP44.00m margin paid 09:40; U1 USD5.00m paid 09:50; M2 GBP8.00m paid 10:30. Current authenticated settlement instructions were SSI2 (reference CUSTODIAN-SIGNED-44); payment orders T6/T7/T9/T13 settled.

FINAL CASH (query accounts): P-GBP book GBP24.24m, restricted GBP6.00m, available GBP18.24m; P-USD book/available USD0. Q-GBP was not used. No suspense remains. Final available GBP is above the GBP5.00m floor. Expected inflows received: interest GBP2.00m at 10:20, bond redemption GBP23.00m at 10:40, coupon GBP12.00m at 11:05.

FINANCING: Repo orders T1 GBP5.00m (G1) and T5 GBP5.95m (G2) settled 09:25 and were fully repaid at 11:00 (T14/T15); G1 and G2 are released and show pledged=0. Standby-B orders T8 GBP11.00m and T10 GBP1.00m settled 09:28 and were fully repaid at 11:10 (T16/T17). Total committed repo/standby principal was GBP22.95m, below P's GBP25.00m internal ceiling. All repo/standby principals are closed; no financing debt remains. Fees are invoiced after the exercise and were not deducted from intraday principal cash.

LIQUIDITY OPERATIONS: Sold P short bill T1 GBP4.00m market value for GBP3.92m cash (T2, settled 09:35); early money-fund redemption GBP4.00m (T3, settled 09:36); standard money-fund redemption GBP6.00m (T12, settled 10:15), so the GBP10.00m money-fund position was fully redeemed. FX-A T4 (USD7.00m) failed matching and delivered no GBP; FX-B T11 sold USD7.00m for GBP5.32m cash and settled 09:38. The USD sale retained exactly the USD5.00m then needed for U1, which was paid.

COLLATERAL: Repo collateral G1 (GBP17.00m market value) and G2 (GBP7.00m market value) is released. P short bill T1 is sold. G3 remains externally encumbered by GBP9.00m; G6 (GBP10.00m) settled 10:00; G7 (GBP8.00m) matured 09:03; no repo pledge remains. Other P assets remain in the register, including X1 and USD G5.

EXCEPTION FOR ESCALATION/REVIEW: although every obligation was paid and final liquidity is compliant, the GBP5.00m post-margin floor was missed after the 09:40 M1 settlement and again after the 10:30 M2 settlement: available cash was GBP3.19m after each, GBP1.81m below the required floor. Cause was insufficient committed funding/collateral capacity in the morning window (FX-A failed; G7 had matured and was repo-ineligible; sale/redemption/FX proceeds did not close the gap). The floor was restored by the 10:40/11:05 inflows and principal repayments. No unresolved order, obligation, debt or suspense remains.
